arguments.command:
find /workspace -print | sort
echo '--- headers ---'
find /workspace -type f -print | sort | while IFS= read -r f; do
  echo "== $f =="
  head -n 3 -- "$f"
done

arguments.text: Confirmed hello.nv, example.nv, greet.nv, README.template, and config.nv.example self-identify as nova init generator output. prototype1.nv, prototype2.nv, doodle.nv, notes.nv, and scratch.nv, and the files under src/ and tests/, do not.
